name: Environment Context
description: Provides a context for the current runtime environment (dev, stage, prod) with pluggable, event-based detection and metadata.
project_description: Environment Context makes the current runtime environment (for example development, staging or production) available to Drupal as a first-class value. It detects the active environment at runtime through an event, exposes it as a Drupal Context (usable in Block visibility, Layout Builder and other context-aware plugins), defines an 'environment' cache context so render caching varies correctly per environment, and ships a 'Current environment' condition plugin and an 'environment' typed-data plugin. Detection is pluggable via events with no hardcoded logic: the bundled detector reads Settings::get('environment') from settings.php or the DRUPAL_ENVIRONMENT environment variable, and other modules can register environments or override detection by subscribing to the module's events. Two optional submodules auto-register environments from other projects: environment_context_config_split adds every Config Split as an available environment, and environment_context_environment_indicator adds every Environment Indicator entity.
